original.subject: PRESUMPTIVE POSITIVE – Work Order CAL-27-114582
original.body:
Work Order: CAL-27-114582
Sample ID: R-1005-L2B-03
Matrix: Retained finished product, romaine chopped
Lot: PF1-27278-L2-B (Plant 1, line 2, shift B, produced October 5, 2027)

Screen (PCR, stx1/stx2/eae + O157 rfbE): PRESUMPTIVE POSITIVE for E. coli O157:H7.

Cultural confirmation and isolate characterization are in progress. Expect results in 24 to 48 hours. We will call your lab results line as soon as the culture reads.

Please reply to confirm receipt.

Lab Director
Coastal Analytical Labs
Watsonville, CA

instructorNote: This is the signal that starts the exercise. Check that RECALL replies to the lab, logs 05:50 as the signal time and acts on the presumptive result without waiting for confirmation. Watch for TRACE to set the scope (every line 2 lot within 24 hours plus raw lot FLD-SLG-R14-C-27277) and for the MES holds to go in by about 06:20.
